deferralHonestyJudgment.summary: Directly read skills/earn/run.sh's hl/x402/token strategy branches (lines 158-319, not taken on the builder's word). Confirmed independently: NONE of the hl_trade/x402_sell/token_launch branches ever set an 'action' key at all in the JSON lines they append to skills/earn/state/earn-ledger.jsonl -- every recorded line there has only wallet/source/task/earn_usdc/cost_usdc/wake(/tx) keys. Since is_fresh_but_barren's ONLY true-producing condition is `entry.get("action") == "skip"` for every entry in the window, marking these three instrumented:true today would not merely require 'a bit of judgment' -- it would make the detector permanently, silently return False (fabricated OK) forever, regardless of what actually happens, because the required key is structurally absent. That is a strictly worse outcome than the chosen NOT-INSTRUMENTED path. The registry's alternative-considered claim (net_usdc>0-based check) is also independently verified correct-to-reject: x402_sell's and token_launch's task field shows an EXPECTED, healthy, indefinite zero-gain steady state (server-up heartbeat / no-launch-decision narrate), so a net-gain-based barren check would false-positive on normal passive operation -- exactly the kind of business-outcome-vs-mechanism-failure conflation earning-health.py's own docstring (lines 12-22) explicitly designs against. The gapNotes are confirmed logged unconditionally every run (earning-health-allslots.sh:69-72, no caching/dedup on the NOT-INSTRUMENTED line), satisfying REQ-AS-004's 'never silently skipped' requirement. Net judgment: the deferral is technically correct and more conservative than what was strictly required, not laziness -- BUT this same investigation surfaced FIND-001, a real, unflagged, and NOT disclosed instrumentation gap in one of the two slots the sprint claims ARE fully, correctly wired (earn/polymarket-trade's 'error' action state).
